values.heading: Everything to keep you moving.
values.intro: We make finding the right equipment from reputable brands easier than ever at Rechtien Truck Group. Whether you need a commercial truck, trailer, or school bus, we have the equipment you need to keep your business moving.

items.title: Trucks
items.body: Shop our wide selection of new and pre-owned International trucks built to handle any job, equipped with advanced telematics via OnCommand Connection for real-time fleet insights.

items.title: Trailers
items.body: Explore our diverse inventory of trailers, including flatbeds, dump trailers, and reefers, from trusted brands like Dorsey and East.

items.title: IC Bus
items.body: Built for safety and reliability, our IC Bus selection offers top-of-the-line school and commercial buses from industry-leading manufacturers.

items.title: Yard Trucks & Forklifts
items.body: Kalmar Ottawa yard trucks and Navigator forklifts deliver the reliability and power your business needs to run smoothly day after day.

items.title: Service
items.body: We offer full-service repairs for trucks and trailers at our certified service centers, plus mobile maintenance support so we come to you.

items.title: Parts
items.body: Order genuine parts online or in-store at our parts departments across South Florida and South Carolina.

items.title: Financing
items.body: Get financing options for your next truck or trailer purchase, with a team ready to walk you through it.

items.title: Lease & Rental Department
items.body: Short- and long-term leasing and rental plans backed by Idealease. To reach our Lease & Rental team, please call.

image.alt: Red International truck on the lot

props.text: At Rechtien Truck Group, we offer only the best quality for the best price — International trucks, IC Bus, Hino, and trailers from industry leaders like Dorsey, East & Summit. When you choose a truck or trailer through us, you’re investing in durability, reliability, and innovation.
Tell us what you’re moving, and we’ll match you with a trailer built for the job. Our team is ready to help. Explore our diverse selection of new and used trailers today.
